input.title: JP Morgan Chase Bank London Branch joins FICC GSD Netting System
input.summary: DTCC notice GOV2282-26 announces JP Morgan Chase Bank, NA/London Branch as a new participant in the Netting System of FICC's Government Securities Division (GSD #9816). This expands the pool of GSD netting participants.
named_participants: JP Morgan Chase Bank, NA/London Branch
evidence_quotes: New Participant in the Netting System of the Government Securities Division of FICC: JP Morgan Chase Bank, NA/London Branch – GSD #9816
input.notes: Summary-only DTCC notice. JP Morgan Chase Bank is a major participant (GSIB). The notice confirms a new GSD netting membership, which is directly relevant to GSD onboarding and Sponsored volume (FICC-GSD-03). Effect date set to announced date as no separate effective date is stated. The London Branch designation may indicate a non-US entity joining under the Treasury clearing mandate, but the article does not explicitly state this link.
